fullDescription: SecretX is an enterprise-grade professional dark mode interface featuring a high-contrast palette of deep black and primary gold (#fac306). It utilizes a bento-grid layout, glassmorphic navigation, and technical typography (General Sans paired with JetBrains Mono) to create a high-security, infrastructure-management aesthetic. Suitable for cybersecurity platforms, DevOps dashboards, fintech backends, and industrial IoT monitoring systems. Key features include animated status indicators, glowing elevation effects, and high-density technical data tables.
prompt:
## Resumo
A professional enterprise dashboard in dark mode with a bold gold primary accent (#fac306), technical monospace typography for data, and a clean grid-based architecture for managing complex system entities.

## Estilo Visual
Create a pixel-perfect enterprise UI with a background of #000000. Primary accent color is #fac306. Secondary UI elements use Zinc Grays: #0f0f0f (surface), #1a1a1a (elevated), and #262626 (borders). Typography: Use 'General Sans' for headings and body, and 'JetBrains Mono' for all technical IDs, IP addresses, and logs. Headings should be bold with tracking-tight. Buttons have a border-radius of 8px (rounded-lg) and cards have 16px (rounded-2xl). Implement 'glass-panel' effects using background: rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.7) and backdrop-filter: blur(12px). Include a 'gold-glow' shadow effect: box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(250, 195, 6, 0.15). Animations: Include a 'status-pulse' effect on indicator dots (scale 0.95 to 1.05, opacity 0.5 to 1.0, 2s infinite). Hover states for cards should include a subtle translateY(-2px) and border-color: rgba(250, 195, 6, 0.3).

## Layout e Estrutura

### NavigationBar
Fixed top navigation, 64px height (h-16), background black/80 with 12px blur. Left section: Logo (shield icon in #fac306 box) and uppercase brand name. Center section: Horizontal nav links with 14px font-size (text-sm) and medium weight, using #a3a3a3 for inactive and white/bg-white/5 for active states. Right section: Status badge (pill-shaped, emerald or gold background-opacity 10%, with pulse icon), notification bell with red dot, and circular avatar (32px).

### HeaderSection
Breadcrumb-style header area. Left: H1 (30px/text-3xl) bold title with a zinc-500 subtitle below. Right: Flex container with a search input (zinc-900 bg, pl-10 for icon) and a primary 'Create' button (#fac306 bg, black text, bold, uppercase tracking-widest).

### EntityGrid
Responsive grid (1 col mobile, 4 col desktop) with 24px (gap-6) spacing. Each card: 16px border-radius, zinc-900/40 background. Content includes: Top-left icon (24px) in a colored light-tint box (emerald, blue, or purple), top-right context menu icons, card title (20px bold), short description (line-clamp-2), and a linear progress bar (h-1.5) for status metrics. Bottom of card: flex row showing member counts and a text-link action in gold (#fac306).

### ManagementWorkspace
Split layout. Left column (2/3 width): Data table in a zinc-900/40 container. Table header: uppercase, 12px bold text, zinc-500. Table rows: subtle hover state (white/2% opacity), 14px font-size, using JetBrains Mono for date/time strings. Right column (1/3 width): Stacked widget area. Widget 1: Access Policy (list of switches/toggles in gold). Widget 2: Audit Trail (vertical timeline with small status dots, using monospace font for timestamps).

### FooterStatusBar
Fixed height of 32px (h-8), zinc-900 background, border-t white/5%. Text: 10px, bold, uppercase, zinc-600, tracking-widest. Left: flex items for API and engine health with 4px circular status indicators. Right: Version number and legal strings.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Technical Progress Bar — Slim status indicator for resource usage or online percentages.
A container with h-1.5, bg-zinc-800, and rounded-full. The active fill should use high-saturation colors (Emerald #10b981 or Gold #fac306) and have a subtle outer glow shadow matching its color.

### Policy Toggle — A custom enterprise-style switch for dashboard permissions.
A rounded-full container 40px wide, 20px high (w-10 h-5). Active state: bg-#fac306 with a black circular knob (12px) positioned 4px from the right. Inactive state: bg-zinc-700 with a zinc-500 knob positioned 4px from the left.

### Status Pulse Dot — Animated indicator for live connections.
A 6px circular div (w-1.5 h-1.5) with absolute border-radius-full. Background color matches the status (Emerald for online, Red for alert). CSS Animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite (0% {transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0.5;} 50% {transform: scale(1.05); opacity: 1;} 100% {transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0.5;}).

style.description: The style is 'Industrial Enterprise Dark'. It uses a deep black (#000000) background with elevated surfaces in zinc grays (#0f0f0f, #1a1a1a). Typography relies on 'General Sans' for hierarchy and 'JetBrains Mono' for technical data points like IDs and status codes. Primary interactions are highlighted with #fac306 (Gold). Visual accents include emerald, red, and blue for status-based color coding. Borders are kept subtle (white/5% opacity) to maintain a sleek, integrated look.
